settings.calendarAccountsHint: Link Microsoft via OAuth, or Apple iCloud via an app-specific password. Linking keeps one app account across providers.
settings.appleInstructionsTitle: How to create an app-specific password
settings.appleInstructions:
1. Open appleid.apple.com and sign in.
2. Go to Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords.
3. Generate a password (name it e.g. “luefy”).
4. Paste that password here — not your Apple account password.
5. Two-factor authentication must be on for your Apple ID.

settings.appCalendarNameHint: Events created by this app are written to a separate Google calendar with this title. Rename it here anytime; if Google is connected, the calendar title updates automatically.

settings.notLinkedHint: Calendar is linked automatically when you sign in with Google. Sign out and sign in again if this status does not update.

help.name: Shown in your calendar and, once it has a time, in Google Calendar.
help.status: Completed and canceled tasks are not placed again. Events already in Google Calendar stay there.
help.phase: A part of your day from Settings. The task is placed only inside that phase's hours and days. Any time = between wake-up and sleep.
help.when: Pick the first day, then the last (or the same day again). The start clock is on the first day, the end clock on the last. Times use {{timeZone}}.
help.repeat: Every week: on the days below (none = every day). Bi-weekly: those days every other week. Monthly: once a month, on the date of the first occurrence.
help.duration: How long it takes. The planner looks for a free gap at least this long.
help.preferredStart: Optional. The task takes this time and shifts only a flexible task it overlaps. If a fixed event is there, you are asked. Empty = the nearest free gap, nobody is moved.
help.seriesDates: When the series starts and ends. Empty = from now, with no end date. Days use {{timeZone}}.
help.priority: For your own sorting. The planner does not use it to decide which task gets a slot.
help.repeatFixed: Every occurrence keeps this exact time and length; the planner never moves it. A day where another fixed item already sits goes to Problematic.
help.seriesUntil: Last day of the series. Empty = no end date. Days use {{timeZone}}.

fixed.title: Fixed: exact time
fixed.body: An appointment with a set start and end: a meeting, a doctor's visit, a flight.
points: The planner never moves it. Other tasks are placed around it.
No phase and no date window: the time you pick is the time.
Can repeat: each occurrence keeps the same time.
Syncs to Google Calendar as a regular event.
If it overlaps another fixed item, you are asked what to do.

flexible.title: Flexible: the planner finds the time
flexible.body: Something that needs time, but not at a precise hour.
points: Placed in a free gap inside the phase and the dates you allow.
A preferred start is a wish: it takes that time and shifts only the flexible task it overlaps.
If nothing fits in the dates, it goes to Later with a warning.
Syncs to Google Calendar once it has a slot.

recurring.title: Recurring: a habit or routine
recurring.body: Something that repeats on a pattern.
points: Every occurrence up to the planning horizon is placed when you save.
Runs only on the days you pick and the phase's days.
A day that doesn't fit is skipped. The rest of the series stays.
Syncs to Google Calendar as one repeating series.

unscheduled.title: Later: no time yet
unscheduled.body: An idea or to-do you'll get to when you have time.
points: Not placed in the calendar and not synced to Google Calendar.
Waits in Later on the Tasks page until you press Schedule.
